facts.fact: 清算开场：他把爽约说成「按钮被按过」——不质问、不示弱，先记账。
facts.anchor: “You stood me up, Edie. Consider my buttons pushed.”

facts.fact: 轨道失重：一进他的轨道，「离他远点」的警铃消失，原地出现一个放纵的女人。
facts.anchor: when I’m in his orbit, that little voice inside my head telling me I should stay the hell away from him disappears, and in its place, this wanton woman appears.

facts.fact: 禁止结束：她说到此为止，他一个 No 截住——你没资格结束我们的事；她回嘴说想干什么就干什么。
facts.anchor: “You don’t get to end things between us.” “Actually, I can do whatever the hell I want. As a matter of fact…”

facts.fact: 惩罚判决：他早有预告——惩罚有多种形式，这就是其中之一（在临界点收手）。
facts.anchor: “I warned you, Edie. Punishment can come in many forms. This is one of them.”

facts.fact: 回声之痛：身体的钝痛呼应胸口的痛；她刹住哭意——不让他看出受影响，更不让他看出多疼。
facts.anchor: All I’m left with is a dull ache inside my core that echoes the one inside my chest, and I almost sob with frustration, but I catch myself before I can. I refuse to let him see how much he’s affecting me. More than that, I refuse to let him see how much this hurts.

facts.fact: 冷手线索：他的手冰凉，解释只有一句——我体温比大多数人低一点。
facts.anchor: “Do you have a circulation problem or something? Your hands are so cold.” I let out a sigh, avoiding his question all together. Of course, he doesn’t let it go. “I run a little cooler than most people.

facts.fact: 婚内账目（临床陈述）：与前夫的性里他从未让她满足过——十五年间一次都没有。
facts.anchor: On the occasions when I did have sex with my ex, he never made me come. Not once in fifteen years.

facts.fact: 失眠快照：他睡熟后她醒着盯天花板、觉得自己被用完——想不通自己怎么跟了这么残忍的男人。
facts.anchor: What you did in there, it took me back to those moments lying awake after he’d fallen asleep, staring at the ceiling, feeling used, and wondering what the hell I was doing with a man so fucking cruel.

facts.fact: 独立宣言：她值得更好的、她也有需求——人生第一次拒绝忽视它们。
facts.anchor: I deserve better than that. I have needs too. For the first time in my life, I refuse to ignore them.

facts.fact: 测试揭晓：爽约是想看他到底多想要她——大概算是个测试。
facts.anchor: “I wanted to see how much you truly wanted me,” I say, finally admitting to myself why I did what I did. “It was a test?” “I suppose it was.”

facts.fact: 权力渴望：那种掌控感她从未体验过——想有一次全权在握，想有人追她一次。
facts.anchor: I’ve never experienced anything like that before. I guess I wanted to be the one with all the power for once. I wanted someone to chase me.

facts.fact: 改变承诺：他愿意探索新相处模式——不保证不故态复萌，但会为她试。
facts.anchor: “I’m willing to explore a new dynamic. I can’t promise I won’t slip up and revert to what I’m used to, but I’m going to try for you.

facts.fact: 终审：人生第一次，她觉得找到了愿意把她的需求放在自己前面的男人。
facts.anchor: for the first time in my life I finally feel as though I’ve found a man who’s willing to put my needs before his own.
